item.title: wrong context
item.body:
Type: Bug idk what this is about. I think when i clicked the history button to bring back up my last conversation it brought one up from yesterday or something. it just decided to open a file that was not in context, and edit it. I did not have the file open, i did not provided it in context, i did not mention in it a prompt. it just randomly opened a random file for no reason and started editing it and seems to of forgotten the entire rest of the conversation. I think maybe the history thing is broken.
